note: Spec v1.1 §22: every FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT TESTED / NEEDS PHYSICAL DEVICE and open decision; a critical one blocks the release until its evidence exists.

risks.reason: Emulators cannot show HDR / Dolby Vision, real codecs, gesture feel, SD card / SAF on removable storage, real performance
risks.needs: The owner's phone, on the final release (owner's decision NVP15-CHG-0003)
risks.impact: Player, subtitle and storage behaviour on real hardware unproven
risks.closes_when: The owner's checks after installing the release (POST-RELEASE VALIDATION, NVP15-CHG-0005): PRV-01..07

risks.reason: Notification test (#48): Android 9 full pause and resume PASS (required check). Android 14: Pause PASS; Resume NOT TESTED, because Android 14 lets an app start a user-initiated download job from the background only after a real tap, which an automated PendingIntent.send() is not
risks.needs: Owner's phone: start a download, leave the app, Pause then Resume from the notification
risks.impact: The app side of pause/resume from the notification is tested on both emulators; the physical tap is not
risks.alternatives: Fix the test until the real scenario passes
risks.closes_when: Owner's tap on Resume from the notification on Android 14+ after installing (PRV-05, NVP15-CHG-0005)

risks.reason: B15-SEC-04 fixed in #44 (merged); real playback of credentialed streams not yet seen on a device
risks.impact: Tokens readable on a hostile network until merged
risks.alternatives: Keep; verify with tokens (chosen); verify always
risks.closes_when: Owner confirms his sources still play

risks.reason: MpvSurfaceTest.restoresVideoAfterSeekingAndRecreatingTheSurface failed once on the Android 14 emulator (run 45013015432, job 137180684762, PR #85, which changes no app code): ActivityScenario.moveToState(CREATED) timed out ('Activity never becomes requested state [CREATED]', last transition RESUMED) before the surface was recreated, so the behaviour under test was not reached. The re-run of that job passed (137183895933), as did Android 9 and 16 in the same run; 1 failure in the last 40 device-test runs
risks.needs: Further runs; the test's own lifecycle step is the emulator's ActivityScenario, not app code
risks.impact: A required check can fail without an app fault; a real surface regression is still caught (the test fails on the video check, not on this step)
risks.alternatives: Re-run and record (chosen); wait longer for the lifecycle move; replace the activity stop by visibility only (would test less)
risks.closes_when: No recurrence over the device-test runs up to the release candidate, or the cause found

risks.reason: Nuvio-code findings of the logs and storage audit (security-logs-storage.md): W5-LOG-01 (Medium) add-on and plugin request URLs, which can carry a debrid key, written to logcat; W5-LOG-02..05 (Low) stream and subtitle URLs, redactedForLogs keeping userinfo and path, a partial Trakt token in debug logs, Sentry breadcrumbs with URL path; W5-STO-01 (Low) Trakt tokens and debrid keys in plain app-private SharedPreferences; W5-STO-02 (Low) no data extraction rules with target SDK 36. Also from #91: manifest bodies have no size limit in httpGetText
risks.needs: A fix in Nuvio's code, proposed in the report
risks.impact: Logcat is readable only with adb or by the system on Android 4.1+; plain values sit in the app sandbox. No Plus code is affected; the regression guard fails any new sensitive log call
risks.alternatives: Keep recorded with a proposed fix (owner's choice, NVP15-CHG-0007); fix in Plus (changes Nuvio's code, out of scope); report upstream
risks.closes_when: Fixed upstream and synced, or fixed in Plus after a new owner decision

risks.reason: Intermittent CI failures seen on 2026-11-22 without an app change: the Android 9 device-test job of #87 hung for the full 60 min and was cancelled (rerun passed); DeviceSubtitleStatesTest.libmpvHandlesADeviceSubtitleAcrossStateChanges failed once on Android 14 on #90, which changes no app code (first failure in about 50 runs; rerun passed); the Android 9 notification test twice read the downloads list during a rewrite (fixed in #97)
risks.needs: Watch the runs up to the release candidate; a second subtitle-delay failure is treated as an app defect
risks.impact: A required check can fail or hang without an app fault
risks.alternatives: Re-run once and record (chosen); investigate on recurrence
risks.closes_when: No recurrence on the release candidate's runs

risks.reason: Signed-in server journeys of profiles and accounts are not tested: sign-in, sign-out, session expiry, account switch, cloud sync of profiles and settings, online PIN check and lock-out, server-side profile deletion and a second device. They need a Nuvio account server and a test account; the code is Nuvio's (Plus's local profile isolation and deletion cleanup are tested).
risks.needs: A Nuvio test account and server, or the owner's own account after release
risks.impact: A defect in Nuvio's server account flows would not be caught before release; Plus's per-profile data isolation is covered by host tests
risks.alternatives: Test with a test account before release; accept and check after release (chosen by the owner)
risks.closes_when: The owner (or a test account) runs sign-in, sync, PIN online and server-side profile deletion on Build 16 after release and reports the result

closed.reason: The #93 measurement prints drawn bounds under 48 dp on the downloads queue (icon buttons 40x40 dp, pause season 40x35 dp in landscape, header buttons 80x40 and 93x40 dp). That is the drawn size, not the touch area: Compose widens a smaller target to its 48 dp minimum touch size unless a neighbour is closer (the measurement's own comment). The real touch area was not measured
closed.closes_when: Every listed control is shown to take taps over at least 48 x 48 dp
closed.evidence: PR #117 merged (merge SHA 1e53e9547574266f122716013e3aa9cac1b29390): PlusReferenceScreenshotsTest reads each control's touchBoundsInRoot and fails on Plus-owned screens when a touch area is under 48 dp. Nuvio Plus checks run 45642684537 at 6e4f7c972881baf58cbdcb29a7a1f9202d43d7d0: 2393 tests, 0 failed (only the six portrait-phone player cases skipped, as designed), so every control of the downloads queue and the other Plus screens takes taps over at least 48 x 48 dp in English and Arabic on phone, phone landscape and tablet.
